thresholds_chosen: Stricter than the 98%-precision pair train.py picks on renders (0.64/0.31): that pair made 3 confident wrong votes on 19 real crops. At 0.9/0.1 the model votes on 91.1% of held-out renders at 99.4% (present) and 99.0% (absent) precision, and made no wrong vote on the real crops (10 votes).

real_frames.note: Two device frames of a finished KALLAX 4x2 (recognition-anchored); absent crops are 4x4 rows projected onto the wall above it. Not used for training; the frames are not in the repository.
